name: Olbart Dunkelkenn
japaneseName: オルバルト・ダンクルケン
description: Olbart Dunkelkenn is the former Third ranking Divine General of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and the venerable chieftain of the Vollachian Shinobi Village, infamous as the 'Vicious Old Man'. A cunning master of shinobi techniques, including a secret art that reverts targets to childhood, he served as a terrifying antagonist in Chaosflame during Arc 7 before aligning with the Imperial loyalists in Arc 8.
